# outside the imperial bloc; the empire itself holds no land in georgia_area; the author's Caucasian march has not

}

# BYZ scope. The chronicle (gen_chronicle.py row geo, hooks in plan_20261117/v66/r2-geo1_实施.md and r2-geo23_实施.md).
# The chronicle tests void, then ended, then under way. Phases 2-3 widen the row to 1356-1453: void = nothing of the
# line happened and it is void or over; ended = it is void or over; under way = from the first window (1356), or once
# something has happened.
oe_geo_chr_void = { oe_geo_none_all = yes OR = { has_variable = oe_geo_void oe_geo_all_over = yes } }
oe_geo_chr_done = { OR = { has_variable = oe_geo_void oe_geo_all_over = yes } }
oe_geo_chr_run = { OR = { current_date >= 1356.1.1 oe_geo_none_all = no } }
